information.description:
Ogres are similar to Brutalizers, but are more fist-oriented, use heavier armor, and sport neural enhancers to ensure they can reach you by the time their autopistols are empty. They aren’t quite as smart as some other members, but for the Animals, brute strength and resilience tends to work just fine.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Animals).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

The preferred pistol among Night City cops – light, wieldy, and easy on the recoil, it's perfect for taking down enemies without necessarily killing them on the spot. Thanks to its relatively small dimensions, the gun has also found a loyal following among those who prefer a concealed carry: the Lexington easily fits in a coat pocket or purse. And for design lovers, its classic 2030s frame remains stunning as ever.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

The modern Kerenzikov takes the place of the now defunct Reflex Co-Processor to help reduce the strain on the user's Neuroport.

Neuralware. The user can now dodge Ranged Attacks if they could not do so already, and gain a +2 bonus to Checks for noticing Ambushes.

NOTE: Credit to Infernox_Ratchet for the basis of this item.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Kerenzikov; use this one instead of the core item.
  • The +2 is on Perception and situational, because it only applies to noticing an Ambush: tick it in the roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).

If you want to stay in the game, you’re going to need a boost.

Kerenzikov Cyberware Enhancement. The Kerenzikov now counts as Speedware and also provides a +2 bonus to initiative at all times. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.
